message.reasoning: We got pager: checkout error rate above 5%. check_health shows unhealthy services: checkout, payments. Logs show checkout errors due to upstream payments returned 502. Payments logs show 401 Unauthorized due to key expired. We rotated secret for payments. After rotate, health is healthy. So root cause: payments provider key expired, causing checkout errors. We fixed by rotating secret. That is the smallest safe change. Conclude.

function.arguments: {"cause":"bad_flag","root_cause_service":"payments","summary":"Payments service was using an expired API key, causing 401 errors that bubbled up to checkout as 502 responses. Rotating the provider secret resolved the issue and restored service health."}
